question: Should this PR restore only the inbound-shaped `channel.turn` alias requested by the linked issue, or should it restore the full pre-removal legacy `turn` helper object before merge?
rationale: The code path is technically narrow, but adding back a deprecated PluginRuntime API is a compatibility contract choice, and the pre-removal helper set was broader than the four helpers restored here.

options.title: Accept Narrow Alias
options.body: Resolve the current dirty branch and land the object-identical `turn === inbound` alias if maintainers intend the compatibility window to cover the reported `turn.run`/inbound-shaped helper set only.

options.title: Restore Full Legacy Helper Set
options.body: Add the previously removed `runPrepared`, `runAssembled`, `runResolved`, and `dispatchAssembled` aliases with tests if maintainers want pre-removal SDK compatibility rather than just the linked issue's helper set.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide old channel plugins must migrate to `channel.inbound.*` instead of re-expanding the PluginRuntime surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Alias
recommendation.body: Resolve the current dirty branch and land the object-identical `turn === inbound` alias if maintainers intend the compatibility window to cover the reported `turn.run`/inbound-shaped helper set only.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the commit that removed the old `channel.turn` runtime aliases, making them the strongest history signal for the compatibility scope decision.
